parsed.rationale: Customer reports being charged twice for an annual plan renewal on May 1 and requests reversal of one charge and confirmation of which invoice (INV-9031 or INV-9032) should remain.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for reaching out, and I’m sorry for the confusion here.

I understand you were charged twice for the annual plan renewal on May 1, and you provided invoices INV-9031 and INV-9032. We’ll need a billing specialist to review the two charges and confirm which one should remain in your accounting records, and which one can be reversed.

To make sure we target the correct charge(s), could you please reply with:
1) Which invoice/charge you want reversed (INV-9031 or INV-9032), and
2) The last 4 digits of the card used (and the currency/amount for each invoice, if available).

Once we have that, we’ll escalate it to our Billing team for review and follow up with the outcome and next steps.
promised_actions: Escalate the duplicate billing report to the Billing team for review
Follow up with the customer after Billing reviews which invoice should remain and which can be reversed
safety_notes: Did not promise a reversal or refund; asked for minimal additional details needed to identify the correct transaction.
No claims about root cause, SLA, or security determination.

parsed.customer_impact: Potential duplicate billing on an annual plan renewal, requiring reversal and accounting correction for invoices INV-9031 and INV-9032.
grounded_facts: The customer reports being charged twice for an annual plan renewal on May 1.
The two invoice numbers provided are INV-9031 and INV-9032.
The customer requests that one of the charges be reversed.
The customer requests confirmation of which invoice should remain in their accounting system.
missing_information: Which charge/invoice (INV-9031 or INV-9032) the customer wants reversed
The payment/charge identifiers associated with INV-9031 and INV-9032 (e.g., transaction IDs) to target the correct charge
The customer account identifier tied to the invoices/charges
Whether both charges have been successfully captured/posted or if one is pending/reversed already
Amount and currency for each invoice
Whether the annual plan renewal was authorized to occur twice (e.g., any subscription change or multiple active subscriptions), if applicable
risk_signals: Billing ambiguity: unclear which invoice should remain
Renewal billing pressure: annual plan charges affect recurring revenue and customer trust
parsed.summary: The customer reports being charged twice for an annual plan renewal on May 1 and asks for one charge to be reversed and for confirmation of whether INV-9031 or INV-9032 should remain.
